title: New on OTT Fri 20 Nov: Dhindora 2, Steps (Netflix); Percy Jackson S3 (JioHotstar, finale 11 Dec); Anbil Avan (SonyLIV); Teen Tigada (ZEE5)
headline: 5 OTT Releases This Weekend: Dhindora 2, Steps, Percy Jackson
caption:
Five new films and series reach Indian streaming apps on Friday, 20 November.

Netflix has Dhindora Season 2, Bhuvan Bam's Hindi comedy: he plays a whole family of characters, led by Titu Mama, who is nursing an ₹11 crore loss. It also has Steps, an animated film that retells Cinderella from her stepsisters' side, with Ali Wong, Amanda Seyfried and new songs from JENNIE.

JioHotstar starts Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3, adapted from The Titan's Curse. Episodes 1 and 2 arrive on Friday, then two more every Friday until the finale on 11 December.

SonyLIV streams Anbil Avan, the Tamil romantic thriller with Ashok Selvan and Preity Mukhundhan, seven weeks after it reached cinemas on 2 October. ZEE5 premieres Teen Tigada, a Hindi series about an aspiring cricketer and a musician.

Which OTT app does your family pay for?

Sources: Netflix, Deccan Herald, Esquire India, The Hollywood Reporter India, Disney+, UNI, IANS, Pratidin Time
